args.body: Take SQLITE-EDUCATIONAL-DOWNLOAD-RIGHTS-FALLBACK under a valid lease. Start with the exact archive inventory and file-specific grants. If both members have documented redistribution authority, pass the existing execution receipt and those grants to MARKETPLACE_CHECKOUT and skip replacement. If a member lacks evidence, author a standalone exercise from scratch with fictional data, SQL and bilingual instructions. Keep the uncertain member out of the new package. Execute the documented learner command from the exact archive in a clean directory and capture the expected mismatch and corrected result. Record authorship and any grant still required for each payload. Read back the committed package or rights handoff and close under the actual lease with a lesson. Keep it staged. Any public release requires host-enforced independent review of the exact digest.
